Inspired by legendary American playwright Eugene O’Neill’s original play, A Long Day’s Journey Into Night, Pan Pan’s new interpretation, Long Day’s Journey, travels further into the sub-conscious hallucinatory world of O’Neill’s original work that spotlights themes of addiction, depression and despair.
